title: Rav Chana bar Chinena
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 106b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.106b.2), asking Rav Huna; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chana bar Ketina.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1374&lang=en) name Rav Chana bar Chinena as the one asking Rav Huna. Hyman reports the form bar Ketina from Dikdukei Soferim.
